intro: Named countdowns that viewers start with a channel point reward, such as Streamer muted 5:00 or No swearing 10:00. Each running timer shows on stream with the viewer's picture and a bar that empties. No Streamer.bot import is needed.

sections.title: 1. Timers
sections.notice: Type each reward's title exactly as viewers see it on Twitch or Kick (capital letters do not matter). The two example timers do nothing until you give them a reward title. Simulated test redemptions never start a timer.

sections.title: 2. Chat
sections.notice: Only moderators and you can use the command.

sections.title: 3. On stream
sections.notice: Add http://127.0.0.1:8787/overlay/addons/thsv.reward-timers as a 1920x1080 browser source in the scenes where the timers should show.

columns.label: Reward title
columns.hint: Exact Twitch or Kick reward name

labels.add: Add its time to what is left
labels.restart: Start it again from the top
